name: seo-keyword-tracker
description: SEO keyword tracker — crawls a client website, derives likely keywords and SEO issues, and tracks rank positions over time.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,worker,web -c blue,magenta,green "npm -w api run dev" "npm -w api run worker" "npm -w web run dev"
scripts.build: npm -w api run build && npm -w web run build
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
